description: The seventh layer of the track: the engineer who directs agents and keeps ownership of architecture, correctness and review.
Building production software with coding agents under human ownership, with specs, tests, review and measured results.
Accepting generated code without reading or testing it. Fine for throwaway prototypes, a bad practice in production.
The module's checkpoint: one project combining retrieval, tools over MCP, a budgeted agent with a verifier, a permission policy, evals, a threat model and a governance map.
The track's freshness routine: status boxes and the What Changed changelog are checked and updated every quarter.
